northStar: A friend can receive an invitation, pass readiness checks, and reach responsive gameplay in under ten minutes across the widest truthful set of legally owned games.

productTargets.truthRule: Every failed path returns one stable public reason, one action, and no unsupported compatibility claim.

operatingPolicy.permissionPromptPolicy: Approve Authenticated Shell prompts only for the bounded task; verify the command actually began, record the command/result receipt, and treat a prompt approval without execution evidence as not started.
operatingPolicy.staleTabRecoveryPolicy: Before acting on a room or tab, verify exact target identity and current immutable evidence. If stale, missing, or uncertain, quarantine the old dispatch and issue a distinct recovery identity without replaying the prior action.
operatingPolicy.artifactIntegrityPolicy: No artifact version supersedes another without exact bytes or canonical location, byte length, SHA-256, foundation/base identity, and reviewer verdicts tied to those exact bytes.
operatingPolicy.completionContinuityPolicy: Every completed task must immediately create or unblock exactly one next bounded task, with owner, scope, evidence gate, and rollback point.

Route the widest truthful set of games without pretending all engines support the same network model.
Ship only independently reviewed, reproducible, reversible releases.
Recruit players and fund infrastructure without weakening local-first trust.

risks.risk: NAT and firewall diversity can make direct peer-to-peer success unpredictable.
risks.mitigation: Measure before launch, return precise diagnostics, and design an optional transparent relay fallback.

risks.risk: Any-game language can overstate engine, ownership, audio, controller, or determinism support.
risks.mitigation: Route every exact tuple to verified, experimental, external, or blocked with evidence.

risks.risk: Invitations and unauthenticated discovery can be replayed, substituted, or abused.
risks.mitigation: Use bounded short-lived invitations, authenticated authority, exactly-once slots, and abuse tests.

risks.risk: Parallel teams can duplicate work, collide on files, or leave rejected work without closure.
risks.mitigation: One active item per owner lane, exact scope locks, reviewer-owned remediation, and stale-task escalation.

risks.risk: Relay costs can grow faster than voluntary funding.
risks.mitigation: Set explicit capacity, cost, consent, and stop-loss limits before deployment.
